blocks.text: Easekey makes the release of held tension visible in a flat mechanical tile. Its small inset latch unlocks a woven grille, opening a clear space at its center. The name describes that everyday action; its care effects remain those recorded below.
A flat release tile. Unlock its woven grille and let the tension ease.
One-shot use: The amber grille unlocks into diagonal corner braces, revealing a turquoise center as small square motes rise. The tile stays open; the game performs the final fade.

13 silver. Injury / Chronic severity −1; reaching zero clears the treated condition. Health +3; Happiness +8. Health +4 more if Chronic remains after treatment. No recovery-timer change or Potion Boost.

Original PixelLab replacement artwork and reviewed 17-frame use animation, October 28, 2026. Image aef1889b-43fa-4c4b-83c0-16494c614f21; animation d7c8e7ac-0de2-45a9-a774-d92cc839c291. Reduced motion holds the closed tile.
